pages.title: Strange Matter Singularity
pages.text: Strange matter pellets crushed into a single point. Strange matter may be the true ground state of matter, converting anything it touches. This point seems eager, and I keep it well away from anything else.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Strange matter could convert ordinary matter on contact. Compressing enough of it in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that is, so far, content to stay put.
